title: Return Location and After-Hours Drop Terms for Courtesy Transportation Agreements
content:
Store operations terms for Courtesy Transportation Agreements on where a loaner may be returned within the Kessler Automotive Group stores and whether it may be dropped after hours. Amounts are in US dollars.

| Program | Must be returned to the issuing store | Fee when returned to another group store | After-hours drop allowed |
|---|---|---|---|
| Same-Day Courtesy Loaner | Yes | 0.00 | No |
| Courtesy Loaner - Compact | No | 49.00 | Yes |
| Courtesy Loaner - Midsize | No | 49.00 | Yes |
| Courtesy Loaner - SUV | No | 59.00 | Yes |
| Warranty Rental Loaner | No | 49.00 | Yes |
| Fleet Replacement Unit | No | 0.00 | Yes |

## Terms

- **Same-store return**: a switch stating whether the loaner must be returned to the issuing store. Only the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner requires it.
- **Other-store return fee**: the fee when the loaner is returned to another group store. It is 49.00 for the Compact, Midsize and Warranty Rental Loaner programs, 59.00 for the Courtesy Loaner - SUV and 0.00 for the Fleet Replacement Unit. The Same-Day Courtesy Loaner shows 0.00, a program whose loaner must come back to the issuing store.
- **After-hours drop**: a switch stating whether the loaner may be dropped after hours. Where it is allowed, the return date of an after-hours drop is the next business morning's check-in date. Only the Same-Day Courtesy Loaner does not allow it.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Courtesy Loaner - SUV issued at one Kessler store and returned to a different Kessler store carries the 59.00 other-store return fee; the same loaner returned to its issuing store carries none. A Courtesy Loaner - Compact dropped after hours on a hypothetical Tuesday evening and checked in on Wednesday morning has a return date of Wednesday. The days of the week are invented for the example.
